units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 49b:17">B. Kam. 49ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 21:33">Ex. XXI, 33</cite>) <he>אם על פ׳ חייב על כרייה וכ׳</he> if he is responsible for opening a pit, how much more is he so for digging! <cite ref="Exodus 21:33">Ib.</cite> <he>על עסקי פ׳ וכ׳</he> for the act of opening &c. (the pit itself being on private ground). Ib. 50ᵃ.
<cite ref="Pesachim 54a:6">Pes. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>פְּתִיחַת פי האתון</he> the opening of the mouth of (Balaam’s) ass; <he>פ׳ פי הארץ</he> the opening of the mouth of the earth (to swallow Korah).

Gen. R. s. 13 בזו פ׳ ובזו פ׳ with reference to the one (sustenance) opening (the stem פתח) is used (Deut. XXVIII, 12) , and with reference to the other (resurrection) opening is used (Ez. XXXVII, 1; a. fr.—2) פְּתִיחַת נדר (v. פָּתַח) offering reasons for regretting a vow.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 8:7:3">Y. Ned. VIII, end, 41ᵃ</cite>; Y. Naz. VII, 52ᵃ top; a. e.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:1">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>רבנן עבדין יתהון פ׳ לויהי וכ׳</he> the Rabbis used them (the verses <cite ref="Song of Songs 1:2">Cant. I, 2</cite> sq.) as a text for a lecture on Vayhi &c. (<cite ref="Numbers 7">Num. VII</cite>).
